scientific_integrity: Finite incidence checks and a standard global-cohomological proof; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The genus 45 is a cohomological local geometric genus, not a full resolution-graph classification. The result assumes a smooth quadratic avoiding the twelve branch triple points and does not address all degree-nine abelian models. Publication priority beyond accessible sources is not certified.
title: Thirteen singularities and a geometric-genus-\(45\) vertex on a normal degree-nine abelian model
